name: Mandar Dehadrai
player_statement:
A complete player, Mandar Dehadrai has made a big mark in cricket. With 20 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 48*, with an average of 20.80 and a quick strike rate of 107.22. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 25 sixes and 15 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 14.5 overs, taking 5 wickets at an economy rate of 7.21. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
